)

def load(name):
    return load_program(os.path.join(BENCH, name))


def scene_for(name):
    return reset_scene().load_program(load(name))


class TestScene(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_classes_and_methods_registered(self):
        scene = scene_for("01_simple_flow.json")
        self.assertIn("com.example.SimpleFlowActivity", scene.classes)
        self.assertIn("android.util.Log", scene.classes)
        m = scene.get_method(
            "<com.example.SimpleFlowActivity: void onCreate(android.os.Bundle)>"
        )
        self.assertIsNotNone(m)
        self.assertTrue(m.has_active_body())

    def test_library_vs_application_split(self):
        scene = scene_for("01_simple_flow.json")
        app = [c.name for c in scene.application_classes()]
        lib = [c.name for c in scene.library_classes()]
        self.assertEqual(app, ["com.example.SimpleFlowActivity"])
        self.assertIn("android.util.Log", lib)
        self.assertIn("android.telephony.TelephonyManager", lib)

    def test_entry_points_resolved(self):
        scene = scene_for("05_lifecycle.json")
        eps = sorted(m.signature.method_name for m in scene.get_entry_points())
        self.assertEqual(eps, ["onCreate", "onResume"])

    def test_entry_points_deduplicated(self):
        # onCreate is both listed in entry_points and flagged is_entry_point.
        scene = scene_for("01_simple_flow.json")
        self.assertEqual(len(scene.get_entry_points()), 1)

    def test_android_components(self):
        scene = scene_for("01_simple_flow.json")
        comps = [c.name for c in scene.android_components()]
        self.assertEqual(comps, ["com.example.SimpleFlowActivity"])

    def test_reset_scene_is_isolated(self):
        s1 = scene_for("01_simple_flow.json")
        s2 = scene_for("07_no_leak.json")
        self.assertIsNot(s1, s2)
        self.assertNotIn("com.example.SafeActivity", s1.classes)
        self.assertNotIn("com.example.SimpleFlowActivity", s2.classes)


class TestJimpleIR(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.scene = scene_for("01_simple_flow.json")
        self.body = self.scene.get_method(
            "<com.example.SimpleFlowActivity: void onCreate(android.os.Bundle)>"
        ).body

    def test_units_and_locals(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(self.body), 6)
        self.assertEqual(self.body.this_local, "r0")
        self.assertEqual(self.body.param_locals, ["r1"])
        self.assertTrue(self.body.is_local("r3"))

import os

import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

from flowdroid_analysis import (

    ZERO,
    AccessPath,
    AliasManager,
    DefaultTaintWrapper,
    FlowDroidAnalysis,
    Leak,
    LifecycleModel,
    SourceSinkManager,
    TaintAbstraction,

)
from soot_analysis import reset_scene

BENCH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "benchmarks")


def load(name):
    return load_program(os.path.join(BENCH, name))


class TestAccessPath(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_str_and_equality(self):
        ap = AccessPath.of("r4", ["data"])
        self.assertEqual(str(ap), "r4.data")
        self.assertEqual(ap, AccessPath.of("r4", ["data"]))
        self.assertEqual(hash(ap), hash(AccessPath.of("r4", ["data"])))

    def test_with_and_drop_field(self):
        ap = AccessPath.of("r0").with_field("a").with_field("b")
        self.assertEqual(str(ap), "r0.a.b")
        self.assertEqual(str(ap.drop_first_field()), "r0.b")

    def test_rebase(self):
        self.assertEqual(str(AccessPath.of("r0", ["f"]).rebase("r9")), "r9.f")

    def test_prepend_to(self):
        # r3 tainted; storing into r4.data yields r4.data
        self.assertEqual(str(AccessPath.of("r3").prepend_to("r4", "data")), "r4.data")
        # r3.x tainted; storing into r4.data yields r4.data.x
        self.assertEqual(str(AccessPath.of("r3", ["x"]).prepend_to("r4", "data")), "r4.data.x")

    def test_k_limiting(self):
        ap = AccessPath.of("r0", [f"f{i}" for i in range(ACCESS_PATH_LENGTH + 4)])
        self.assertEqual(len(ap.fields), ACCESS_PATH_LENGTH)
        self.assertTrue(ap.taint_sub_fields)

    def test_can_read_field(self):
        self.assertTrue(AccessPath.of("r4", ["data"]).can_read_field("data"))
        self.assertFalse(AccessPath.of("r4", ["data"]).can_read_field("other"))
        # Whole object tainted under .* semantics
        self.assertTrue(AccessPath.of("r4", (), True).can_read_field("anything"))
        self.assertFalse(AccessPath.of("r4", (), False).can_read_field("anything"))

    def test_starts_with(self):
        long = AccessPath.of("r0", ["a", "b"])
        self.assertTrue(long.starts_with(AccessPath.of("r0", ["a"])))
        self.assertFalse(AccessPath.of("r0", ["a"]).starts_with(long))
        self.assertFalse(long.starts_with(AccessPath.of("r1", ["a"])))

    def test_is_local_only(self):
        self.assertTrue(AccessPath.of("r0").is_local_only)
        self.assertFalse(AccessPath.of("r0", ["f"]).is_local_only)


class TestTaintAbstraction(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_zero_fact(self):
        self.assertTrue(ZERO.is_zero)
        self.assertEqual(str(ZERO), "ZERO")

    def test_derive_keeps_provenance(self):
        f = TaintAbstraction(
            access_path=AccessPath.of("r3"),
            source_stmt=3,
            source_method="<M: void m()>",
            source_api="getDeviceId",
            source_category="UNIQUE_IDENTIFIER",
        )
        d = f.derive(AccessPath.of("r5"))
        self.assertEqual(d.source_stmt, 3)
        self.assertEqual(d.source_api, "getDeviceId")
        self.assertEqual(d.source_category, "UNIQUE_IDENTIFIER")
        self.assertFalse(d.is_zero)

    def test_alias_marker_in_str(self):
        f = TaintAbstraction(access_path=AccessPath.of("r5", ["data"]), is_alias=True)
        self.assertEqual(str(f), "r5.data(alias)")

    def test_hashable(self):
        a = TaintAbstraction(access_path=AccessPath.of("r1"), source_stmt=1)
        b = TaintAbstraction(access_path=AccessPath.of("r1"), source_stmt=1)
        self.assertEqual({a}, {a, b})


class TestSourceSinkManager(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.program = load("01_simple_flow.json")
        scene = reset_scene().load_program(self.program)
        self.body = scene.get_method(
            "<com.example.SimpleFlowActivity: void onCreate(android.os.Bundle)>"
        ).body
        self.ssm = SourceSinkManager(self.program)

    def test_identifies_source(self):
        u = self.body.unit_by_id(3)
        self.assertTrue(self.ssm.is_source(u))
        self.assertFalse(self.ssm.is_sink(u))
        self.assertEqual(self.ssm.source_category(u), "UNIQUE_IDENTIFIER")
        self.assertEqual(self.ssm.api_name(u), "getDeviceId")

    def test_identifies_sink(self):
        u = self.body.unit_by_id(4)
        self.assertTrue(self.ssm.is_sink(u))
        self.assertEqual(self.ssm.sink_category(u), "LOG")
        self.assertEqual(self.ssm.api_name(u), "i")

    def test_plain_call_is_neither(self):
        u = self.body.unit_by_id(2)
        self.assertFalse(self.ssm.is_source(u))
        self.assertFalse(self.ssm.is_sink(u))

    def test_spec_fallback_without_statement_flags(self):
        # Clear the statement flags: the spec alone must still classify.
        for cls in self.program.classes:
            for m in cls.methods:
                if m.body:
                    for s in m.body.statements:
                        s.is_source = s.is_sink = False
        scene = reset_scene().load_program(self.program)
        body = scene.get_method(
            "<com.example.SimpleFlowActivity: void onCreate(android.os.Bundle)>"
        ).body
        ssm = SourceSinkManager(self.program)
        self.assertTrue(ssm.is_source(body.unit_by_id(3)))
        self.assertTrue(ssm.is_sink(body.unit_by_id(4)))


class TestAliasManager(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_copy_creates_alias_set(self):
        scene = reset_scene().load_program(load("04_alias_handling.json"))
        body = scene.get_method(
            "<com.example.AliasActivity: void onCreate(android.os.Bundle)>"
        ).body
        am = AliasManager(body)
        self.assertTrue(am.may_alias("r4", "r5"))
        self.assertIn("r5", am.aliases_of("r4"))
        self.assertIn("r4", am.aliases_of("r5"))

    def test_unrelated_locals_do_not_alias(self):
        scene = reset_scene().load_program(load("04_alias_handling.json"))
        body = scene.get_method(
            "<com.example.AliasActivity: void onCreate(android.os.Bundle)>"
        ).body
        am = AliasManager(body)
        self.assertFalse(am.may_alias("r4", "r6"))

    def test_alias_sets_are_sorted(self):
        scene = reset_scene().load_program(load("04_alias_handling.json"))
        body = scene.get_method(
            "<com.example.AliasActivity: void onCreate(android.os.Bundle)>"
        ).body
        am = AliasManager(body)
        self.assertEqual(am.aliases_of("r4"), sorted(am.aliases_of("r4")))


class TestLifecycleModel(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_callbacks_in_canonical_order(self):
        scene = reset_scene().load_program(load("05_lifecycle.json"))
        lm = LifecycleModel(scene)
        names = [m.name for m in lm.lifecycle_methods_of("com.example.LifecycleActivity")]
        self.assertEqual(names, ["onCreate", "onResume"])

    def test_dummy_main_invokes_every_callback(self):
        scene = reset_scene().load_program(load("05_lifecycle.json"))
        lm = LifecycleModel(scene)
        dummy = lm.build_dummy_main("com.example.LifecycleActivity")
        self.assertIsNotNone(dummy)
        called = [u.callee.method_name for u in dummy.body if u.is_invoke()]
        self.assertEqual(called, ["onCreate", "onResume"])
        self.assertTrue(dummy.is_static)

    def test_dummy_main_allocates_component_once(self):
        scene = reset_scene().load_program(load("05_lifecycle.json"))
        dummy = LifecycleModel(scene).build_dummy_main("com.example.LifecycleActivity")
        allocs = [u for u in dummy.body if u.kind == "new" and u.rhs.endswith("LifecycleActivity")]
        self.assertEqual(len(allocs), 1)

    def test_no_dummy_main_for_unknown_class(self):
        scene = reset_scene().load_program(load("05_lifecycle.json"))
        self.assertIsNone(LifecycleModel(scene).build_dummy_main("does.not.Exist"))

    def test_synthetic_ids_do_not_collide(self):
        scene = reset_scene().load_program(load("05_lifecycle.json"))
        dummy = LifecycleModel(scene).build_dummy_main("com.example.LifecycleActivity")
        real_ids = set()
        for m in scene.methods_with_bodies():
            if m is dummy:
                continue
            real_ids |= {u.stmt_id for u in m.body}
        self.assertFalse({u.stmt_id for u in dummy.body} & real_ids)


class TestDefaultTaintWrapper(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        scene = reset_scene().load_program(load("03_interprocedural.json"))
        self.body = scene.get_method(
            "<com.example.InterActivity: java.lang.String obfuscate(java.lang.String)>"
        ).body

        self.assertEqual(self.w.get_taints_for_method(unit, fact, self.body), [])

       "param_types": ["java.lang.String", "java.lang.String"], "return_type": "int"}

    {"name": "android.telephony.TelephonyManager", "is_library": True,

    def _branch_program(self, sink_on_tainted_branch):
        """if (c) { t = secret } else { t = "safe" }  then leak t."""
        tainted, safe = (4, 5) if sink_on_tainted_branch else (5, 4)
        stmts = [
            {"stmt_id": 0, "kind": "identity", "lhs": "r0", "rhs": "@this"},
            {"stmt_id": 1, "kind": "identity", "lhs": "r1", "rhs": "@parameter0"},
            src_call(2, "rs"),
            {"stmt_id": 3, "kind": "if", "condition": "rs != null",
             "true_target": 4, "false_target": 5, "rhs_vars": ["rs"]},
            {"stmt_id": 4, "kind": "assign", "lhs": "rt", "rhs": "rs", "rhs_vars": ["rs"]},
            {"stmt_id": 5, "kind": "assign", "lhs": "rt", "rhs": '"safe"'},
            sink_call(6, "rt"),
            {"stmt_id": 7, "kind": "return"},
        ]
        # Make the two branches converge on the sink.
        stmts[4]["kind"] = "assign"
        cls = activity("com.example.BranchActivity", [{
            "signature": oncreate_sig("com.example.BranchActivity"),
            "is_entry_point": True,
            "body": {
                "this_local": "r0", "param_locals": ["r1"],
                "locals": [{"name": n, "type": "java.lang.String"}
